name: activitysmith-github-action
description: The official ActivitySmith GitHub Action. Send push notifications, drive Live Activities, update widget metrics, and set app icon badge counts from workflows.

scripts.build: ncc build src/index.js --license licenses.txt --source-map && node tools/normalize-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run check:dist
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && node --check dist/index.js && git diff --exit-code -- dist

author: ActivitySmith
